selection_rationale: Selected after exploratory validation comparison of fixed, frequency-adaptive, and context-adaptive KG fusion. A1_frequency_3 improves zero-shot Hit@10 and catalog coverage while maintaining an approximately 0.33 percentage point overall Hit@10 reduction relative to fixed fusion. The approximately 0.00451 absolute NDCG@10 reduction is accepted and must be reported.
test_selection_policy: No changes to method, strength, base alpha, RRF constant, hub cutoff, or baseline set based on held-out test results.
